measure.measure_definition: Measured clinical quantity: wake after sleep onset (WASO).; Participants; Objective sleep assessment in the Phase 3 trial; the supplied abstract identifies WASO as an objective insomnia variable.  WASO is wake time after sleep onset. Assessed at baseline and month 3 in the mild-OSA subgroup.

Measured clinical quantity: latency to persistent sleep (LPS).; Participants; Polysomnography (PSG). LPS is the time from start of recording to the beginning of the first continuous 20 epochs (i.e., 10 minutes) scored as non-awake, i.e., epochs scored as sleep stage 1, sleep stage 2, sleep stage 3 (slow wave sleep) or REM.; Change from baseline to Month 3 in LPS measured by PSG.

Measured clinical quantity: subjective total sleep time (sTST).; Participants; Sleep diary questionnaire; total sleep time reported by the participant.; A positive change from baseline indicates an increase in subjective total sleep time; a negative change indicates a decrease. Assessed at baseline and month 3 in the mild-OSA subgroup.
